story_sequence.text: `beacon.utils.truth_map` exists and exposes resolver APIs for feature truth package paths.
Generated truth-map JSON is marked projection/diagnostic and cannot be accepted as authoritative input.
Feature package Markdown carries enough contract markers for v1.5.2 canonical promotion.
Resolver exposes stable constants for source model and parser contracts.
New truth consumers call resolver APIs instead of constructing legacy truth paths.
Skill templates instruct LLMs to read truth map and feature package before legacy artifacts.
QA must not require an equivalent JSON projection for every Markdown truth document.
Doctor route can rebuild legacy triptych from feature package or reports unsupported gaps explicitly.
Change route can absorb legacy triptych into feature package or reports unsupported gaps explicitly.
Verify command fails or warns when resolver output disagrees with package files or rebuild metadata.
Truth-map route can rebuild requirement-derived `.machine` JSON from resolver-selected Markdown.
Generated machine JSON is labeled as generated state/evidence, not truth.
Generated machine JSON records resolver contract, source paths, and source hashes.
Runtime/process JSON is allowed without Markdown twins and is not requirement authority.
Verify fails closed when `.machine` JSON is stale, non-resolver-generated, or source-hash mismatched.
Resolver resolves version governance truth in addition to feature package truth.
Resolver classifies feature truth, version governance truth, generated governance state, and runtime/process records.
Manifest/index/cache JSON is never accepted as truth authority.
Material audit reads through resolver before using manifest or old paths.
QA, release, and status read governance truth through resolver-first routes.
Missing governance truth or drifted generated governance state fails closed.
Version governance materials are not moved into `features/<slug>/`.
Generated governance JSON/state carries non-authority labels or equivalent declarations.

Implement plan/dev-run surfaces verify version governance metadata branch contract before planning or execution, and fail closed when metadata, current branch, and git workflow expected branch disagree.

v1.5.1 may route normal truth reads, write-target resolution, gate input resolution, legacy rebuild targets, and legacy absorb targets through truth_center; it must not switch truth authority from `feature_package_authoritative_ready` to `feature_package_authoritative` until v1.5.2 policy flip.

v1.5.1 tracks high-risk truth read/write entrypoints, including PRD/user-story/test-case/workflow/truth/gate commands, PRD bootstrap, requirement clarity/deepening, manifest, acceptance kit, packaged skills, and `.agents/skills`; each entrypoint routes through truth_center/resolver or is explicitly classified as a v1.5.1 legacy/generated/runtime exception with fail-closed or v1.5.2 cutover handling.

artifact_read_model.summary: machine completeness projection is missing, but Markdown-first requirement truth is frozen and parseable

decision_traceability.summary: human requirement truth is carried by frozen Markdown surfaces

coverage_closure.summary: acceptance coverage is parseable from Markdown truth

downgrade_control.summary: missing completeness projection does not activate a truth downgrade

stage_admission.summary: qa admission uses frozen Markdown truth; projection sync is advisory
